# powerhmc_vios (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) partition.

Use this data source to look up an existing VIOS partition and read its processor, memory, and I/O configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing VIOS partition by managed system and VIOS name.
data "powerhmc_vios" "my_vios" {
  system_name = "my-managed-system"
  vios_name   = "vios1"
}

output "vios_uuid" {
  value = data.powerhmc_vios.my_vios.vios_uuid
}

output "vios_state" {
  value = data.powerhmc_vios.my_vios.state
}

output "vios_ip_address" {
  value = data.powerhmc_vios.my_vios.ip_address
}

output "vios_memory" {
  value = data.powerhmc_vios.my_vios.mem_config
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system where the VIOS resides.
- `vios_name` (String) Name of the VIOS partition.

### Read-Only

- `io_slots` (List of String) List of I/O slot physical locations assigned to the VIOS.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the VIOS for resource monitoring (RMC).
- `mem_config` (Attributes) Memory configuration for the VIOS partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mem_config))
- `os_version` (String) Operating system version running on the VIOS.
- `proc_config` (Attributes) Processor configuration for the VIOS partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proc_config))
- `profile_name` (String) Name of the partition profile.
- `reference_code` (String) Reference code associated with the VIOS partition.
- `rmc_state` (String) Current RMC (Resource Monitoring and Control) state of the VIOS partition.
- `state` (String) Current state of the VIOS partition (e.g., `running`, `not activated`).
- `vios_uuid` (String) UUID of the VIOS partition.

<a id="nestedatt--mem_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mem_config`

Read-Only:

- `current_mem` (Number) Current memory in MB.
- `desired` (Number) Desired memory in MB.
- `max` (Number) Maximum memory in MB.
- `min` (Number) Minimum memory in MB.


<a id="nestedatt--proc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proc_config`

Read-Only:

- `current_proc` (Number) Current number of dedicated processors.
- `current_proc_units` (String) Current processing units.
- `current_virtual_proc` (Number) Current number of virtual processors.
- `desired_proc` (Number) Desired number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `desired_proc_units` (String) Desired processing units (for shared mode).
- `desired_virtual_proc` (Number) Desired number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `max_proc` (Number) Maximum number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `max_proc_units` (String) Maximum processing units (for shared mode).
- `max_virtual_proc` (Number) Maximum number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `min_proc` (Number) Minimum number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `min_proc_units` (String) Minimum processing units (for shared mode).
- `min_virtual_proc` (Number) Minimum number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `proc_mode` (String) Processor sharing mode (e.g., `cap`, `uncap`, `keep_idle_procs`).
- `shared_proc_pool_id` (Number) Shared processor pool ID (for shared mode).
